A move.

Prevux übernimmt Aufbau, Werkzeuge, Tast: Prevux adopts the layout, tools, keyboard shortcuts and even the menu names of Preview – “File”, “Save”, “Crop”. If you come from the Mac, you will find everything where your hand looks for it. And if you have never used Preview, you simply get a calm, tidy program for images and PDFs.
Markieren, ausfüllen, unterschreiben, an: Mark up, fill in, sign, adjust – without a second program.
Auf Fotos wie auf PDFs. Die Lupe vergröß: On photos as on PDFs. The loupe magnifies a spot and shows with a line where it comes from. Everything stays editable, even after saving.
Ein krummer Kreis wird ein sauberer Krei: A wobbly circle becomes a clean circle, a shaky arrow a straight one. With a graphics tablet or pen, the line gets thicker the harder you press.
Die Seite fließt unter<br>der Leiste wei:
The page flows on
beneath the toolbar.
Die Symbolleiste ist aus Glas: Beim Scro: The toolbar is made of glass: as you scroll, the document shimmers softly through it. Zooming and scrolling glide smoothly to where your mouse pointer is. Prefer it plain? “Reduce transparency” in the settings.
Felder, Kästchen und Auswahllisten direk: Fields, checkboxes and pop-up lists right in the PDF, with Tab to the next field. You draw your signature – or photograph it on paper, and Prevux turns it into clean lines.
Mehrere Bilder markieren und gemeinsam a: Select several images and adjust them together: fit them to common sizes, in pixels, percent or centimetres – with or without resampling.
Miniaturen, Inhaltsverzeichnis, Lesezeic: Thumbnails, table of contents, bookmarks and search results – one click and you are on the right page.
Mehrere Dateien auf einmal geöffnet? Die: Several files open at once? The sidebar shows them all. Drag pages with the mouse to a new place – even from one PDF into another.
Die kleinen Dinge, die Vorschau so nützl: The little things that make Preview so useful – rebuilt piece by piece.
Viele Dateien in einem Fenster. <kbd>Str: Many files in one window. <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> <kbd>Tab</kbd> moves on, and a tab can be dragged into a window of its own.
Wichtige Seiten mit <kbd>Strg</kbd> <kbd: Remember important pages with <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> <kbd>D</kbd> – they stay even after you close the file.
Bilder und Seiten bildschirmfüllend zeig: Show images and pages full screen – arrow keys to go on, Esc to go back.
Jedes Sichern legt eine Version an. „Zur: Every save creates a version. “Revert To …” brings back an earlier state.
Ein Bild oder gleich mehrere: einpassen: One image or several at once: fit them to common sizes, in pixels, percent or centimetres.
Ein Klick, und das Motiv steht frei – zu: One click and the subject stands free – to reuse as a PNG with transparency.
„Vom Scanner importieren“ – auch über da: “Import from Scanner” – also over the network and with a document feeder straight to PDF. Or take a photo with the camera.
Profil zuweisen und Soft-Proof: Sieh vor: Assign a profile and soft proof: see beforehand how your image will look on the printer.
Geschützte Dateien lassen sich nicht ver: Locked files cannot be changed by accident. Duplicate, rename and move right from the title.
Öffnet mehr als Bilder und PDFs: Opens more than images and PDFs
Markdown, Textdateien, HTML-Seiten und E: Prevux opens Markdown, text files, HTML pages and e-books as neatly typeset documents – for reading, marking up and saving as PDF. The sidebar shows animated GIFs frame by frame.
Zeigt, wo ein Foto entstand – und entfer: Shows where a photo was taken – and removes the location on request before you pass it on.
Verträge, Ausweise, Kontoauszüge, Arztbr: Contracts, ID cards, bank statements, doctors’ letters: what you open in a PDF program is often the most private thing of all. That is why nothing leaves your computer with Prevux.
Geschwärzter Text, Grafiken und Bildpunk: Redacted text, graphics and pixels are really removed from the PDF when saving – not just covered with a bar.
Texterkennung in Fotos und Scans läuft a: Text recognition in photos and scans runs on your computer. No image is uploaded anywhere.
Keine Cookies, keine Schriften oder Dien: No cookies, no third-party fonts or services, no access logs. The JavaScript on this site runs only in your browser and sends nothing.
